22use super::encoder::PDF417;
23
24/**
25 * default white space (margin) around the code
26 */
27const WHITE_SPACE: u32 = 30;
28
29/**
30 * default error correction level
31 */
32const DEFAULT_ERROR_CORRECTION_LEVEL: u32 = 2;
33
34/**
35 * @author Jacob Haynes
36 * @author qwandor@google.com (Andrew Walbran)
37 */
38#[derive(Default)]
39pub struct PDF417Writer;
40
41impl Writer for PDF417Writer {
42    fn encode(
43        &self,
44        contents: &str,
45        format: &crate::BarcodeFormat,
46        width: i32,
47        height: i32,
48    ) -> Result<crate::common::BitMatrix> {
49        self.encode_with_hints(contents, format, width, height, &EncodeHints::default())
50    }
51
52    fn encode_with_hints(
53        &self,
54        contents: &str,
55        format: &crate::BarcodeFormat,
56        width: i32,
57        height: i32,
58        hints: &EncodeHints,
59    ) -> Result<crate::common::BitMatrix> {
60        if format != &BarcodeFormat::PDF_417 {
61            return Err(Exceptions::illegal_argument_with(format!(
62                "Can only encode PDF_417, but got {format}"
63            )));
64        }
65
66        let mut encoder = PDF417::new();
67        let mut margin = WHITE_SPACE;
68        let mut errorCorrectionLevel = DEFAULT_ERROR_CORRECTION_LEVEL;
69        let mut autoECI = false;
70
71        // if !hints.is_empty() {
72        if let Some(compact) = &hints.Pdf417Compact {
73            if let Ok(res) = compact.parse::<bool>() {
74                encoder.setCompact(res);
75            }
76        }
77        if let Some(compaction) = &hints.Pdf417Compaction {
78            encoder.setCompaction(compaction.try_into()?);
79        }
80        if let Some(dimensions) = &hints.Pdf417Dimensions {
81            encoder.setDimensions(
82                dimensions.getMaxCols() as u32,
83                dimensions.getMinCols() as u32,
84                dimensions.getMaxRows() as u32,
85                dimensions.getMinRows() as u32,
86            );
87        }
88        if let Some(m1) = &hints.Margin {
89            if let Ok(m) = m1.parse::<u32>() {
90                margin = m;
91            }
92        }
93        if let Some(ec) = &hints.ErrorCorrection {
94            if let Ok(ec_parsed) = ec.parse::<u32>() {
95                errorCorrectionLevel = ec_parsed;
96            }
97        }
98        if let Some(cs) = &hints.CharacterSet {
99            encoder.setEncoding(CharacterSet::get_character_set_by_name(cs));
100        }
101        if let Some(auto_eci_str) = &hints.Pdf417AutoEci {
102            if let Ok(auto_eci_parsed) = auto_eci_str.parse::<bool>() {
103                autoECI = auto_eci_parsed;
104            }
105        }
106        // }
107
108        Self::bitMatrixFromEncoder(
109            &mut encoder,
110            contents,
111            errorCorrectionLevel,
112            width as u32,
113            height as u32,
114            margin,
115            autoECI,
116        )
117    }
118}
119
120impl PDF417Writer {
121    /**
122     * Takes encoder, accounts for width/height, and retrieves bit matrix
123     */
124    fn bitMatrixFromEncoder(
125        encoder: &mut PDF417,
126        contents: &str,
127        errorCorrectionLevel: u32,
128        width: u32,
129        height: u32,
130        margin: u32,
131        autoECI: bool,
132    ) -> Result<BitMatrix> {
133        encoder.generateBarcodeLogicWithAutoECI(contents, errorCorrectionLevel, autoECI)?;
134
135        let aspectRatio = 4;
136        let mut originalScale = encoder
137            .getBarcodeMatrix()
138            .as_ref()
139            .ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?
140            .getScaledMatrix(1, aspectRatio);
141        let mut rotated = false;
142        if (height > width) != (originalScale[0].len() < originalScale.len()) {
143            originalScale = Self::rotateArray(&originalScale);
144            rotated = true;
145        }
146
147        let scaleX = width as usize / originalScale[0].len();
148        let scaleY = height as usize / originalScale.len();
149        let scale = scaleX.min(scaleY);
150
151        if scale > 1 {
152            let mut scaledMatrix = encoder
153                .getBarcodeMatrix()
154                .as_ref()
155                .ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)?
156                .getScaledMatrix(scale, scale * aspectRatio);
157            if rotated {
158                scaledMatrix = Self::rotateArray(&scaledMatrix);
159            }
160            return Self::bitMatrixFromBitArray(&scaledMatrix, margin)
161                .ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE);
162        }
163
164        Self::bitMatrixFromBitArray(&originalScale, margin).ok_or(Exceptions::ILLEGAL_STATE)
165    }
166
167    /**
168     * This takes an array holding the values of the PDF 417
169     *
170     * @param input a byte array of information with 0 is black, and 1 is white
171     * @param margin border around the barcode
172     * @return BitMatrix of the input
173     */
174    fn bitMatrixFromBitArray(input: &[Vec<u8>], margin: u32) -> Option<BitMatrix> {
175        // Creates the bit matrix with extra space for whitespace
176        let mut output = BitMatrix::new(
177            input[0].len() as u32 + 2 * margin,
178            input.len() as u32 + 2 * margin,
179        )
180        .ok()?;
181        output.clear();
182        let mut y = 0;
183        let mut yOutput = (output.getHeight() - margin - 1) as isize;
184        while y < input.len() {
185            let inputY = &input[y];
186            for (x, x_index_val) in inputY.iter().enumerate().take(input[y].len()) {
187                // Zero is white in the byte matrix
188                if x_index_val == &1 {
189                    output.set(x as u32 + margin, yOutput as u32);
190                }
191            }
192            y += 1;
193            yOutput -= 1;
194        }
195        Some(output)
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * Takes and rotates the it 90 degrees
200     */
201    fn rotateArray(bitarray: &[Vec<u8>]) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
202        let mut temp = vec![vec![0; bitarray.len()]; bitarray[0].len()];
203
204        for ii in 0..bitarray.len() {
205            // This makes the direction consistent on screen when rotating the screen;
206            let inverseii = bitarray.len() - ii - 1;
207            for (jj, tmp_spot) in temp.iter_mut().enumerate().take(bitarray[0].len()) {
208                tmp_spot[inverseii] = bitarray[ii][jj];
209            }
210        }
211
212        temp
213    }
214    pub fn new() -> Self {
215        Self
216    }
217}
